1.e4 Nf6 2.e5 Nd5 3.c4 Nb6 4.c5 Nd5 5.Nc.strategy: Recaptures towards the centre, which opens the d-file and the c1-bishop for quick development. But the d-pawn that could have supported the advanced pawns is gone, and both c5 and e5 stand without pawn support.
Attacks c5 and e5 at once, neither of which has any pawn behind it, and opens the c8-bishop. White cannot easily support both, so the space gained by the pawn advances now comes under pressure.
